title: Father, I Know Thy Ways Are Just
description: Father, I Know Thy Ways Are Just in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 485 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Thy Will be done."”, where the book credits them to the Percy Chapel Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther, I know thy ways are just, Al-though to me un-known; O, grant me grace thy love to trust, And cry, "Thy will be done."

lines: Father, I know thy ways are just,
O, grant me grace thy love to trust,
If thou shouldst hedge with thorns my path;
Should wealth and friends be gone;
Still with a firm and lively faith,
Although thy steps I cannot trace,
And, as instructed by thy grace;

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
